item.title: Fondling suspect at large after report at Portland Community College library
item.description: A man with long, dark hair and a beard wearing a red sweater and small framed glasses with one broken lens was reported to have engaged in unwanted physical contact with a female student in the Sylvania Campus Library at Portland Community College.

item.title: 'Increasingly authoritarian': Oregon senator calls for probe into ICE, CBP funding
item.description: Senator Jeff Merkley (D-OR) is calling for an independent investigation into how federal immigration agencies are spending funds.

item.title: Oregon leaders meet pushback against liability changes for ski, recreation areas from outdoor advocates
item.description: Oregon ski associations and outdoor advocates are pushing back against two bills in Salem that they say would not adequately protect recreation areas from liability, as insurance costs continue to rise.

item.title: Measles exposure reported at Oregon City hospital emergency room
item.description: Oregon Health Authority (OHA) has confirmed another measles exposure at Providence Willamette Falls Medical Center in Oregon City, urging those who believe they were exposed to contact a health care provider immediately.

item.title: Battle Ground teacher reinstated after 'false allegations' of Charlie Kirk comments, union says
item.description: A Battle Ground teacher has been reinstated after it was determined "false allegations" led to her original firing, according to a union representing educators.
